title: Why guitarists USED TO play more in tune! (Microtonal Frets)
summary: Classical guitarist Brandon Acker shows how guitars with tied-on gut frets, as used 300 years ago, can play more in tune than modern fixed metal frets. He demonstrates microtonal and meantone tunings on a guitar with movable frets.
why: Pointed to in tuning and temperament threads as an audible demonstration of how meantone differs from equal temperament.

quote.text: Brandon Acker gives a wonderful overview on the classical guitar
